source_text: Non declinabis iudicium proselyti et orphani et viduae, non accipies pignus vestimentum viduae, quia famulus eras in terra Aegypti et liberavit te Dominus Deus tuus inde; propter hoc ego tibi praecipio facere verbum hoc [n17] . Cum institueret Deus iudicandi formam, hoc statim sancire curavit, ne aut parentes in filiorum aut filii in parentum scelere ferirentur. Principium ergo et ingressum iustitiae, quam servari in iudicatione mandabat, ostendit istud esse, ne affinitas gravaret innoxios et in ipsum genus excurreret odium, quod persona meruisset. In causa ergo actuum discernit iustitia, quos necessitudo coniungit; quod utique non faceret, si una esset ratio voluntatis et seminis aut si opus arbitrii ad posteros fecunditate transiret. Satis ergo superque docuimus hoc uno testimonio taeterrimam istam iudicii pravitatem, quam novus error ample ctitur, antiqua latae legis auctoritate contritam. Quae certe sententia ita est in causam prolata, ut nullum locum reliquerit ambigendi.
pass_a_gloss: You shall not turn aside the judgment of the sojourner and of the orphan and of the widow; you shall not take a widow's garment as pledge, because you were a servant in the land of Egypt and the Lord your God freed you from there; on account of this I command you to do this word. When God was instituting the form of judging, he took care at once to sanction this, that neither parents be struck in the crime of sons nor sons in that of parents. He showed therefore that the beginning and entrance of the justice which he was commanding to be kept in judging is this: that kinship not burden the innocent and that hatred which a person had deserved not run out into the family itself. In the cause of acts, therefore, justice distinguishes those whom necessity of kinship joins; which it would certainly not do if there were one account of will and of seed, or if the work of choice passed to posterity by fecundity. Sufficiently therefore and more than enough we have taught by this one testimony that that most foul perversity of judgment which the new error embraces is crushed by the ancient authority of the enacted law. Which sentence certainly has been brought into the case in such a way that it has left no place for doubting.

pass_b_english: ‘You shall not distort justice for the foreigner, orphan, or widow. You shall not take a widow’s garment as security, because you were a servant in the land of Egypt and the Lord your God freed you from there. That is why I command you to do this’ (Deuteronomy 24:17–18).

When God established the pattern for judging, he immediately took care to decree that neither parents should be struck down for their children’s crimes nor children for their parents’. He showed, then, that the first principle and starting point of the justice he commanded judges to maintain was this: family ties must not burden the innocent, and the hatred an individual had deserved must not spread to the family itself. In matters of conduct, justice therefore distinguishes those whom kinship joins. It certainly would not do so if will and reproductive seed operated on the same principle, or if an act of choice passed to descendants through reproduction. With this single testimony we have shown, more than sufficiently, that the ancient authority of the enacted law crushes the utterly repulsive corruption of judgment embraced by this new error. This pronouncement bears on the case in a way that leaves no room for doubt.

choices.why: Julian's forensic virtue that renders to each his own, without fraude or gratia (partiality).
rejected: righteousness (Pauline overlay unless the verse forces it)

choices.why: Julian's definition of sin is an act of will. Keep 'will' rather than later 'free will' system language unless liberum arbitrium is present.
